title: Measuring Sustainability Intention of ESG Fund Disclosure using Few-Shot Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on using NLP and LLMs to classify financial disclosures into specific ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) categories to identify greenwashing. While ESG inherently touches upon social and governance ethics, the research is aimed at language specificity and transparency analysis in a financial context, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
